plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (gpt-5.4, high effort) REJECTED the literal task spec and red-teamed the design. 3 blocking + 2 non-blocking + 2 suggestions, all resolved: (#1 head-drift TOCTOU on mutable assets/queue head + #2 trusted-author checks wrong identity) ESCALATED to creating session per the explicit 'escalate PAT/trust-boundary posture' instruction; creator chose architecture A: harvest queue's art surface onto current origin/main in a throwaway worktree, force-update a sole-writer bot-owned assets/promote branch, PR that -> main. Trust enforced STRUCTURALLY (promote built on main, art-surface-only by construction) + guard as defense-in-depth on the staged diff; refuse+escalate if a non-art path ever appears. (#3 three-dot realign bug) fixed: do-we-act detection uses two-dot art-surface comparison; the promote commit is built directly on main so two-dot==three-dot for the guard/PR. (#4 reset-push auth) fixed: workflow runs gh auth setup-git. (#5 cross-run concurrency) fixed: workflow concurrency single lane + idempotent PR create. (#6 cold start) fixed: git ls-remote probe before fetch. (#7 tests) all high-risk cases added. NOTABLE reversal: the feature ADR's 'reset assets/queue post-merge' was rejected by the creator as a data-loss trap (queue churns during the ~1h cycle) — harvest-onto-main makes reset unnecessary; queue accumulates. plan_divergence=major_fork recorded honestly.

rounds.notes: gpt-5.4 (high) code review of the PR2 diff. 1 Critical + 2 High + 1 Medium (+1 category clean): (Critical) findOpenPromotePr matched any open PR by title/base without filtering head ref or cross-repo — a fork PR from an untrusted contributor could be hijacked and armed; FIXED by requesting JSON number,headRefName,isCrossRepository and filtering isCrossRepository !== true && headRefName === promoteBranch, applied on both the initial query and the create-race re-query. (High) auto-merge armed without pinning the head — a promote force-update between arm and merge could land a different commit; FIXED with gh pr merge --match-head-commit <promoteCommit>. (High) isArtSurfacePath treated dir allowlist entries as prefix so a sibling like public/assets/generated-evil could pass; FIXED to exact-match .json entries and descendant-only (surface + '/') for dir entries. (Medium) create-race test was vacuous; FIXED by adding FakeGh createRaceInsert mode + a test that exercises create-fail -> re-query -> reuse, plus a cross-repo-fork-ignored test. All 5 resolved; not marked clean because round 2 surfaced a further finding.

gpt-5.4 (high) confirming review. Verified all 5 round-1 fixes correct, and found 1 new High: the trust guard was path-only, so a file->symlink (120000) / gitlink (160000) / mode-only exec (100755) type-change at an allowlisted path (e.g. manifest.json) would pass and auto-land a non-regular-file entry to main (reproduced locally). FIXED by adding assertArtSurfaceModes: parses git diff --cached --raw and rejects any staged entry whose dst mode is not a regular file (100644) or a deletion (000000), re-enforcing the path allowlist on the raw diff; wired as step 5b in runReconcile after the name-only guard; 6 unit tests added (symlink/gitlink/exec/non-art rejection + regular-file/deletion accept). Not marked clean because a later concurrent hardening pass surfaced a further regression (round 3).

Post-round-2 hardening. A concurrent review pass added a preserve-main-only-art regression test (h) — a sprite that reached main via the legacy asset-PR flow, absent from queue, must NOT be deleted by promotion — which failed CI. (High, data-loss) Root-caused with a deterministic real-git repro: the do-we-act delta used `git diff --diff-filter=AM base queue` WITHOUT --no-renames, so git's rename heuristic paired the intended-D (main-only asset, deleted-in-queue) with a content-identical intended-A (genuinely-new queue art) into a single R entry, which --diff-filter=AM drops — silently omitting real queue art from the promotion AND leaving the delete-half unhandled. FIXED by adding --no-renames to the delta diff (and, for determinism/guard-robustness, to the staged --cached --name-only changedPaths diff; the mode-guard --raw diff already had it). Verified both the (h) preserve-main-only scenario and the normal-promote scenario now produce the correct promote diff via the real-git repro. (Medium, deps/merge-hygiene) A parallel PR bumped the brace-expansion override to ^5.0.8, which 404s on the MS npm proxy (proxy latest is 5.0.7) — a latent local `npm ci` break — and main had meanwhile landed the authoritative brace-expansion audit-exception (fa546158b, source 1124334). RESOLVED by reverting override to ^5.0.7 + restoring the lockfile from main and dropping the now-duplicate audit exception/tests, so this PR no longer touches security files and the gate passes via main's landed exception. Both concerns resolved; clean.
